conformer_fallback_policy: Retained if basic checks pass, independently flagged; no equal-accuracy claim for 2D fallback

feature_semantics.zwitterion_fraction: Charge-separated net-zero proxy; includes charged resonance forms such as nitro, not a chemically curated zwitterion classification
feature_semantics.uncharged_atom_fraction: Probability mass of states in which every atom has zero formal charge, not a fraction of individual atoms

feature_scaling: Not performed here; fit imputation and scale on each training fold only
selection: Population-ranked top states with compulsory parent; identical set for uniform/prior
population_scope: Predicted and renormalized on selected guarded states; not measured or exhaustive physical populations
guard_scope: Conservative parent stereo guard can exclude chemically valid transitions
fallback: Parent-only unit state weight with explicit state_prior_available=false; missing scalar features remain NaN
